description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git for-each-repo' builtin command. It sets up git repositories, runs specific commands with various configurations, and verifies expected behaviors. The tests include handling configurations, error scenarios, and command outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of the provided commands.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that the command exits with the specified code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output to expected output.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
